description: This is a test class file for the SugarEmailAddress component in the SuiteCRM project, containing unit tests for various methods related to email address handling, retrieval, and widget rendering.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddressTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of SugarEmailAddress module methods, including address handling, database interactions, and widget rendering in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testSave
methods.description: Tests the save() method of SugarEmailAddress, verifying database interactions and logging behavior during save operations.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Tests the constructor of SugarEmailAddress, checking address index and count consistency.

methods.name: testSugarEmailAddress
methods.description: Repeated test for constructor behavior, confirming address indexing.

methods.name: testHandleLegacySave
methods.description: Verifies handling of legacy save logic including address array population.

methods.name: testHandleLegacyRetrieve
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of legacy email addresses from a bean.

methods.name: testPopulateLegacyFields
methods.description: Tests populating legacy email fields on a bean based on the email address addresses.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Extensive test for saveEmail() method, including database link counts and logging.

methods.name: testGetCountEmailAddressByBean
methods.description: Verifies counting email addresses linked to a bean, including consideration of deletions.

methods.name: testGetRelatedId
methods.description: Tests retrieving related entity IDs via email address.

methods.name: testGetBeansByEmailAddress
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of beans associated with an email address, including handling of missing or invalid addresses.

methods.name: testPopulateAddresses
methods.description: Tests the population of email addresses from request data and database, including various edge cases.

methods.name: testAddAddress
methods.description: Checks the addAddress() method populating the addresses array and database consistency.

methods.name: testUpdateFlags
methods.description: Placeholder for testing updateFlags() method; marked incomplete.

methods.name: testSplitEmailAddress
methods.description: Verifies email address parsing into name and email components under various input scenarios.

methods.name: testCleanAddress
methods.description: Tests address cleaning function to strip out angle brackets and validate address string.

methods.name: testGetEmailGUID
methods.description: Tests retrieval and validation of email GUIDs based on email addresses, including deletion cases.

methods.name: testAddUpdateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates adding and updating email address entries, ensuring proper database entries.

methods.name: testGetPrimaryAddress
methods.description: Verifies correct primary address retrieval for a bean.

methods.name: testGetReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of reply-to addresses, including reply flags and deletions.

methods.name: testGetAddressesByGUID
methods.description: Tests fetching email addresses by GUID and module, with cases for non-existent and existing entries.

methods.name: testGetEmailAddressWidgetEditView
methods.description: Tests the rendering and behavior of the email address widget for editing, with many edge cases.

methods.name: testGetEmailAddressWidgetDetailView
methods.description: Verifies the detail view rendering for email address widget, including handling of non-existing IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmailAddressWidgetDuplicatesView
methods.description: Marked incomplete; environment-dependent test for duplicate email address widget views.

methods.name: testGetFormBaseURL
methods.description: Tests URL generation logic for the email address widget form, covering multiple request scenarios.

methods.name: testSetView
methods.description: Tests the setView() method for changing the view state.

methods.name: testGetCorrectedModule
methods.description: Tests the logic for correcting module names, especially mapping 'Employees' to 'Users'.

methods.name: testStash
methods.description: Checks the stash() method's behavior with null parameters and logging.

methods.name: testGetEmailAddressWidget
methods.description: Tests the high-level getEmailAddressWidget() function for different module and view contexts, expecting HTML snippets. Marked incomplete due to environment dependency.

methods.name: testGetOptInStatus
methods.description: Extensively tests the getOptInStatus() method of SugarEmailAddress under various opt-in configuration scenarios, including different confirmation and failure states. Marked incomplete.
